sys_pd_process_definition.description: BCFA cash application journey: payment & remittance intake, simulated extraction (POC) and correlation, customer, open items, matching & allocation, exceptions & deductions, approval, SAP DRAFT/DIRECT processing (MOCK SAP), closure. A view of the authoritative state only.
sys_pd_process_definition.label: BCFA Cash Application Playbook
sys_pd_process_definition.name: bcfa_cash_application

sys_pd_lane.description: Bank payment received; the remittance advice may arrive with it, later or never (PAYMENT ONLY until it does).
sys_pd_lane.label: 1. Payment & Remittance Intake
sys_pd_lane.name: intake

sys_pd_lane.description: SIMULATED DOCUMENT EXTRACTION — POC for the remittance; correlated to the payment by the system.
sys_pd_lane.label: 2. Extraction & Correlation
sys_pd_lane.name: correlation

sys_pd_lane.description: Customer resolved deterministically (exact or confirmed alias). An ambiguous customer needs a person: AI may rank candidates, never commit one.
sys_pd_lane.label: 3. Customer Resolution
sys_pd_lane.name: customer

sys_pd_lane.description: Open AR items of the resolved customer (MOCK SAP reference data in the POC).
sys_pd_lane.label: 4. Open Item Retrieval
sys_pd_lane.name: open_items

sys_pd_lane.description: MatchingEngine allocates the payment to open items. Allocated, deduction and residual amounts are the engine's own result.
sys_pd_lane.label: 5. Matching & Allocation
sys_pd_lane.name: matching

sys_pd_lane.description: Runs alongside stages 2-5 and completes when no exception is open. Residuals, deductions and other exceptions, with system result, AI recommendation and human decision kept separate.
sys_pd_lane.label: 6. Exception / Deduction Resolution
sys_pd_lane.name: exception

sys_pd_lane.description: Human approval of the allocation and any deduction; ApprovalEngine and segregation of duties are authoritative.
sys_pd_lane.label: 7. Approval
sys_pd_lane.name: approval

sys_pd_lane.description: MOCK SAP. DIRECT: SAP clears immediately. DRAFT: staged (parked) in SAP and cleared only after SAP confirms. Mode from x_695068_bcfa.ar.sap_processing_mode, captured on the payment.
sys_pd_lane.label: 8. SAP Draft / Direct Processing
sys_pd_lane.name: sap_processing

sys_pd_lane.description: Cleared, reconciled and closed; full evidence and audit trail.
sys_pd_lane.label: 9. Closure & Audit
sys_pd_lane.name: closure

sys_variable_value.value: Waiting for MOCK SAP: clearing result, draft confirmation, or reconciliation of an unknown outcome.

IntegrationService sends the approved clearing instruction to MOCK SAP in the payment's processing mode. DRAFT: the payment waits in SAP_DRAFT until SAP confirms the draft (Check SAP Draft Status: a status query, never a re-send). No real SAP posting happens in the POC.
Waiting for the payment to be normalized.
BANK PAYMENT registered. REMITTANCE: listed below when received (PAYMENT ONLY / PAYMENT + REMITTANCE CORRELATED is shown in Blocked Because).
Waiting for the customer's open items.
Open item retrieval — MOCK SAP reference data
Open item retrieval — MOCK SAP reference data
Open AR items of the customer, from the POC master data that stands in for SAP.
The payment is cleared, reconciled and closed. Closure cannot happen while an UNKNOWN_OUTCOME or an unconfirmed SAP draft is open. The audit trail records every system, AI and human action.
Waiting for clearing confirmation, reconciliation and closure.
Approval is a HUMAN DECISION by an authorised approver (deductions above the threshold need a Finance Approver). The requester and the processor cannot approve. AI cannot approve.
Waiting for matching and allocation, or for a person to resolve an unmatched / ambiguous / currency / duplicate exception.

PAYMENT AMOUNT against SELECTED OPEN ITEMS: each allocation below, with the allocated total and residual recorded by the allocation engine (negative residual: short payment; positive: overpayment). Nothing is recalculated here.
Waiting for customer resolution (an ambiguous customer needs a person).
CUSTOMER RESOLVED by deterministic rules (exact code or confirmed alias). If ambiguous: CUSTOMER REVIEW REQUIRED — a person confirms; AI may only recommend.
Remittance extraction & correlation — SIMULATED DOCUMENT EXTRACTION — POC
Remittance fields (remitter, payment reference, invoice references, deductions) were read by the POC extraction simulation and correlated to the payment by the system.
Remittance extraction & correlation — SIMULATED DOCUMENT EXTRACTION — POC
Waiting for open exceptions or deductions to be resolved by their owners.

SYSTEM DETERMINATION is the rule result and residual; AI RECOMMENDATION is advisory (Residual Explanation, Deduction Analysis, Recommended Next Action, Customer Clarification Draft); HUMAN DECISION is the deduction classification or resolution by the authorised person.
Intake: bank line and remittance documents
AI assistance used on this payment (advisory)
MOCK SAP integration transactions: mode, adapter, idempotency key, transmission status, reference, reconciliation
Customer / open-item candidates with confidence (system ranking)
HUMAN DECISION: approval requests, decisions and SoD checks
ALLOCATIONS (allocation engine result), one row per open item
SIMULATED DOCUMENT EXTRACTION — POC: remittance and correlation
Exceptions: SYSTEM DETERMINATION (rule result, residual) | AI RECOMMENDATION (advisory) | HUMAN DECISION
Customer open items (MOCK SAP reference data)
HUMAN DECISION: classified deductions (bank charge, TCS, short pay, credit note)
AI RECOMMENDATION — advisory only (Now Assist): never approves, clears or overrides tolerance
